name: WEIRD Facts & Trivia — 2,500-question reviewed release
publication: Release the complete 2,500-question batch after source, duplicate, editorial and integration checks. User revised the previous 10,000-question release threshold.
numbering: Candidate IDs are editorial identifiers, not published question numbers. Assign permanent folio numbers only at release.
reviewStages: Write an original question around a surprising, worthwhile fact.
Read a supporting source and check both the answer and explanation.
Compare the underlying fact with published questions and explanations, and with the other candidates.
Check clarity, ambiguity, answer spelling, category, difficulty and all four choices.
Record evidence and the editorial decision for every accepted candidate.
Review the complete collection, integrate it and test the offline update before publishing.
difficulty: Keep honest adult difficulty labels. Default game mix remains 70% easy, 10% medium, 10% hard and 10% obscure.
backgroundWork: This is saved editorial work, not a scheduled or automatically continuing job.
